description: Days after a disastrous appearance at the State Fair debate hosted by WIBW Radio, Republican nominee for governor Ty Masterson has rejected future debates against Senator Cindy Holscher. The Holscher campaign had previously accepted debate invitations by Gray Media and Nexstar for September 24 and October 1 debates, respectively. Gray Media stations include KCTV (Kansas City), KWCH (Wichita), and WIBW (Topeka). The Nexstar debate would run on six television stations covering 95% of the state. Masterson turned down both invitations.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Ks-Gov: No-Show Masterson Says No To More Debates After Losing The First One | Cindy Holscher for Governor
